questions.question: What did the king give Esther and Mordecai after Haman's fall?
options: Haman's house and the signet ring
questions.answer: Haman's house and the signet ring

questions.question: Since the first decree could not be revoked, what was issued?
options: A full and complete pardon for all of Haman's family
An order sending the Jews into exile for their safety
A new decree allowing the Jews to defend themselves
A heavy tax laid upon all the enemy provinces
questions.answer: A new decree allowing the Jews to defend themselves

questions.question: Many people of the land became Jews because the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.
Mordecai went out from the king's presence in royal robes of blue and _____.
For the Jews there was light and gladness and joy and _____.
